hotel_name: The St. Regis Bal Harbour Resort

claims.text: The resort rises 27 stories over Collins Avenue and a white-sand beach.

findings.quote: Rising 27 stories over fashionable Collins Ave and a brilliant white-sand beach

claims.text: Bal Harbour sits at the northern tip of Miami Beach.

findings.quote: An oasis of pampering and privilege at the northern tip of Miami Beach, FL, Bal Harbour is one of the most distinguished addresses in South Florida

claims.text: The resort sits on nine acres of oceanfront property and was designed by Sieger Suarez Architectural Partnership.

findings.quote: situated on nine acres of stunning oceanfront property and designed by Sieger Suarez Architectural Partnership

claims.text: The interiors are by Yabu Pushelberg and pay homage to Miami's Art Deco style.

findings.quote: with interiors by world-renowned Yabu Pushelberg that pays homage to Miami’s Art Deco style

claims.text: All rooms have balconies with ocean views.

findings.quote: All of our beachfront accommodations in Miami Beach have balconies with sweeping ocean views

claims.text: Marble bathrooms have walk-in dual-head rainforest showers and separate soaking tubs.

findings.quote: Five-fixture marble baths feature walk-in, dual-head rainforest showers and separate soaking tubs

claims.text: Atlantikos serves Mediterranean dishes in a blue-and-white setting reminiscent of Greece.

findings.quote: With a color scheme reminiscent of the iconic blue and white hues of Greece, our oceanfront hotel restaurant in Miami Beach, Atlantikós, presents an exquisite array of Mediterranean dishes

claims.text: BH Prime is the resort's steakhouse, using locally sourced seasonal ingredients.

findings.quote: Experience BH Prime, a bold new dining concept that redefines the classic steakhouse in Miami Beach. Featuring locally sourced seasonal ingredients

claims.text: La Gourmandise serves the St. Regis Afternoon Tea, which requires a 24-hour advance reservation.

findings.quote: Served daily at our French restaurant in Miami Beach, La Gourmandise
Enjoy the classic St. Regis Afternoon Tea ritual (requires a 24-hr advance reservation).

claims.text: The Spa at St. Regis covers 14,000 square feet.

findings.quote: including The Spa at St. Regis, with 14,000 square feet of indulgence

claims.text: The resort's beach is 1,000 feet long.

findings.quote: Step onto the magnificent 1,000-foot beach, just a few strides from your luxurious retreat.

claims.text: The Family Traditions program offers activities and amenities for children.

findings.quote: our Family Traditions program is a suite of tailored activities and thoughtful amenities

claims.text: A silver cloud sculpture by Inigo Manglano-Ovalle, Cloud Prototype No. 4, hangs from the ceiling at the arrival.

findings.quote: Inigo Manglano-Ovalle’s “Cloud Prototype No. 4”, a captivating silver cloud sculpture suspended from the ceiling motions newcomers and return visitors closer to the Atlantic Ocean

claims.text: A champagne sabering ceremony is performed nightly at 6 pm at the St. Regis Bar.

findings.quote: the art of sabrage is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis Evening Rituals series and is performed nightly at 6:00 pm at our luxury Miami bar
make sure you’re in the St. Regis Bar and Wine Vault by 6 p.m., when a nightly sabering demonstration takes place

claims.text: The Oceanfront Day Villas are 600-square-foot air-conditioned villas with a private indoor lounge and a full bathroom and shower.

findings.quote: Indulge in the luxury of a 600-square-foot air-conditioned Bal Harbour Oceanfront Day Villas, featuring a private indoor lounge area with full bathroom and shower

claims.text: The eight-bedroom Grand Palace Suite on the 23rd floor is the largest suite at the resort.

findings.quote: Accessible via a private hallway on the hotel’s 23rd floor, the Grand Palace Suite is the largest suite offering at the resort with 8-bedrooms

claims.text: The Bal Harbour Shops are directly across Collins Avenue from the hotel.

findings.quote: Located near the hotel, directly across Collins Avenue, these luxury shops serve as an international destination

claims.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.

findings.quote: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

claims.text: The hotel does not provide airport shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
